summary: Phase 0a retrospective classification DONE (no runs). 52 completed note-dependent tasks classified {empirical, external-gap, load-bearing} with quoted evidence. HEADLINE: external-gap base rate = 24/52 = 46% (decision gate NOT tripped — winnable regime is real here); winnable (all three) = 18/52 = 35%; empirical 50%, load-bearing 65%. CAVEAT: self-similar corpus (orchestrator benchmarking its own memory) — 12 of 18 wins are benchmark/memory-meta tasks whose external note is a prior MEASURED verdict, the least-transferable slice; only 6/18 are transfer-robust general-infra (HTTPS issuer-trust, git-substrate-workspace-bound, read-never-write-native, get_full_graph stale+huge, worktree-GC cruft, concurrency collision). Customer external-gap more plausibly ~10-15% than 46%. NOT near-zero → don't abandon, but spend small: targeted Phase-1 A/B on the 6 transfer-robust wins + 3-4 controls to validate proxy precision/recall. Report: bench/frequency-phase0a.md. Note: note-mq7ymupctb8.
